target.name: Dengue Virus NS3 Protease/Helicase
target.domain_rationale: Zero-shot unseen flaviviral serine protease / RNA helicase (0 matches in Davis/BindingDB_Kd); high domain-shift uncertainty and susceptible to macrocycle literature bias.
target.disease_burden: Estimated 100-400 million infections annually across >100 tropical countries with zero FDA-approved direct-acting antivirals.
target.target_biology: Mature NS3 chain (polyprotein residues 1476-2093) essential for viral polyprotein cleavage and RNA replication.
target.reference_note: Non-kinase viral target; rankings are exploratory only and require orthogonal docking / protease assay validation.
target.sequence_region: UniProt mature chain aa 1476-2093 (from polyprotein P29990)
